description: Every case is run through both command line tools by fixtures/run-parity.mjs, and the bytes are compared. {CLAUDE_DIR}, {CODEX_DIR} and {NOW} are substituted, so no run reads a real home directory and no run depends on the day it happens on.

cases.name: summary-default
cases.why: The commonest thing anyone will type.

cases.name: summary-by-model
cases.why: Grouping changes the bucket keys and the ordering.

cases.name: summary-by-week
cases.why: Week bucketing does date arithmetic, which the two languages do differently.

cases.name: summary-by-session
cases.why: Session grouping and its ordering.

cases.name: summary-region-india
cases.why: A different grid factor, so every carbon figure changes.

cases.name: summary-water-onsite
cases.why: The narrow water boundary.

cases.name: summary-water-lifecycle
cases.why: The widest boundary, which brings the embodied uplift into play.

cases.name: summary-provider-carbon
cases.why: The market-based factor, which is opt in.

cases.name: summary-since-window
cases.why: A relative window resolved against the injected clock.

cases.name: summary-empty-window
cases.why: A window with nothing in it must produce the same nothing on both sides.

cases.name: summary-codex
cases.why: The Codex reader, including the replay whose running total goes backwards.

cases.name: sessions-claude
cases.why: Session listing and its ordering.

cases.name: session-alpha
cases.why: The full report, including the heaviest turns and every flag.

cases.name: session-beta
cases.why: A cache-heavy session and a subagent turn.

cases.name: export-json
cases.why: Every turn, every token count, every flag.

cases.name: export-csv
cases.why: The spreadsheet form, where an unknown figure has to be an empty cell on both sides.

cases.name: export-csv-codex
cases.why: The same for rollouts.

cases.name: models
cases.why: The whole model table, which row measures each one, and every downgrade target.

cases.name: models-all
cases.why: The regions as well.

cases.name: recommend-arithmetic
cases.why: A sum we answer locally, and the answer has to be identical.

cases.name: recommend-conversion
cases.why: A conversion, where the two languages round independently.

cases.name: recommend-rewrite
cases.why: A downgrade with a priced saving, which runs the whole engine.
argv: Rewrite this paragraph so it reads more plainly and loses the jargon.

cases.name: recommend-veto
cases.why: A veto, including the wording of the reason.
argv: Explain why this deadlock happens and derive the ordering that prevents it.

cases.name: recommend-local
cases.why: The local tier, which only appears once the user has said they have one.
argv: Turn this list of names into title case.

cases.name: recommend-bottom-of-ladder
cases.why: Nothing smaller to move to.
argv: What is the capital of Australia

cases.name: recommend-deep-conversation
cases.why: Depth changes the answer, and both sides must read the flag the same way.
argv: Rewrite that last paragraph more plainly.
